description.value: BRGR BRGR is a burger-focused casual restaurant in downtown Abbotsford, operating under the tagline 'A Place So Nice They Named It Twice.' The restaurant offers dine-in as well as online ordering for pickup, group orders, and delivery, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley. A loyalty club and delivery app integrations suggest an established local presence.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 27m; rack (3 spaces) at 27m; rack (4 spaces) at 99m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms an active burger restaurant at 33758 Essendene Ave, Abbotsford — matching the OSM address — and explicitly promotes online ordering via its own platform and delivery apps (DoorDash, SkipTheDishes, Uber Eats), confirming takeout. The OSM tags indicate free Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no), but the website does not independently mention it, so Wi-Fi is left null per the rules. No cycling-specific amenities (bike racks, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM name is 'BRGRS BRGR' but the website and OSM brand tag both show 'BRGR BRGR' — likely a typo in the OSM name field.
OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the address (33758 Essendene Ave, V2S 2H2) and the website both place this location in Abbotsford.
Phone number (604) 746-6225 appears on the website but is absent from the OSM record.
Website references 'Our locations' (plural), suggesting this is a chain; only the Abbotsford location is listed in the visible website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active sit-down and takeout burger restaurant with confirmed online ordering; a practical food stop for touring cyclists in the Abbotsford area, pending confirmation of bike parking.
